definition:
per checkpoint (default: every checkpoint of the lineage from segment 30 on, archived ones
  found through mimo_bridge.storage_locations), from model.safetensors:
    attention_gain_top / _second: singular values of the vision prediction head's attention
      value-then-output map W_o W_v (prediction_heads.heads.vision.attn), and the cosine of its top
      input/output direction with the previous checkpoint's;
    memory_readout_norm and the top singular value of each modality slot of the persistent memory's
      readout (the bias added to the newest tokens after the final LayerNorm), and how much of the
      attention map's growing input direction lies in each slot's five main output directions;
    head_first_layer_input_scale, head_output_layer_norm, gaze_copy_in/out norms, and the final
      LayerNorm's gain and bias RMS (the size of the tokens the memory bias is added to);
    vision_encoder_change: relative change and cosine of the vision encoder's weight vector
      against given ancestor checkpoints (the weight-level anchor for encoder drift).
